title: Forzar hábitos
body:
Este tipo de apps parecen una tontería pero es como lo de escribir tus planes, deseos o intenciones en un papel.
El hecho de esforzarte en organizar tus tareas y rutinas diarias hace que las valores más cuando son necesarias.
La aplicación son pago ya es bastante buena.
Muy fácil de usar y visualizar.
De momento en 2 días está genial su concepto.
Completa para establecer cuándo comienza tu mañana, tarde y noche.
Alertas, recordatorios, progresos…
Creo que merece la pena probarla.
Otras apps de este tipo vienen con rutinas programadas por defecto y no puedes crear nuevas o editarlas si no pagas por la app.
Me parece un error de aproximación.
Si ves cómo funciona en “modo normal” y quieres todas las prestaciones pagando me parece mejor.

title: Good, great potential, expensive
body:
The app in its current state, while missing some key features, remains the best in its class.

I enjoy the ease of use, and how they managed to keep it configurable yet intuitive. It's nice to have 4 different tracker types to choose from, although it's a bit of a let down that the suggested trackers are only titles, and not pre-populated templates.

Looking forward to filters for active tracker hours and to exclude completed trackers.

The subscription model is expensive - too expensive for many but I guess they're expecting a high end customer for an almost high end app. They should really start the subscription at a more affordable price. Unsurpassed features are what would allow price increases in the future.

Their feature request & voting service lists some of those missing key features as planned for the current version but seem to have been pushed back to a later release. I hope they eventually get around to implementing them.
